correctness.rationale: The claimed table follows from exhaustive leaf-extension generation through 1301 order-13 isomorphism types and exhaustive homomorphism vectors from 48 source-tree types through order eight. All lower bounds use actual collision classes, including explicit order-13 witness; all upper bounds use full-profile injectivity. A separate NetworkX generator and alternate recursion recover the dimensions; brute-force map enumeration confirms the DP for small cases. No claim beyond n=13.

value.rationale: A natural size budget on tree-shaped homomorphism-count queries is quantitatively distinct from the unlimited tree, path, tree-depth and logical-rank filtrations. The complete smallest-source recognition thresholds through 13 vertices exhibit a previously unaccounted transition: the minimal failure target order for sources of size 7 is 13 rather than the doubled 14 suggested by the preceding four layers. The lone 13-target obstruction and five minimal size-eight separators are precise reusable benchmarks for graph counting kernels and finite-model logic; this is more than a routine evaluation of standard tree counts.
